NOT_HISTORICAL_CLOSURE_EVIDENCE.binding: This artefact is CURRENT-STATE evidence - what a rehearsal of the CURRENT manifest produces. It is NOT historical closure evidence and NOT a sealed or certified artefact. Regenerating it is the OPPOSITE of historical evidence rewriting: leaving it stale is what would misreport the current state.
NOT_HISTORICAL_CLOSURE_EVIDENCE.the_distinction_that_matters: CARRIED VERBATIM IN SUBSTANCE FROM A1_STATUS_DISPOSITION. A historical closure artefact records what was true at a past checkpoint and is immutable. A current-state generated artefact records what the contract computes today and is REQUIRED to move when its inputs move. Conflating the two produces both failure modes - frozen files edited, and live files left stale.
